name: e_phaser
notes: Source sums dry audio with six unit-gain allpass stages. With depth=0 the coefficient is constant 0.97, not a bypass despite the help dry/wet wording. At 440 Hz/22050 Hz, abs(1+((z^-1-0.97)/(1-0.97*z^-1))^6) predicts RMS about 0.10: a phase-cancellation contract, not a generic non-silence test.
